categories.descriptiveVectorText: A government officer or department representative visited, inspected, verified, audited, or checked the business premises, factory, shop, or establishment.
The business renewed a license, registration, permit, approval, certificate, or compliance document with a department.
The business submitted a compliance form, return, declaration, report, document, or regulatory filing.
The business showed electricity, water, gas, utility, or operational resource consumption indicating active business operations.
The business made a fee payment, tax payment, challan payment, penalty payment, or service charge payment.
A department issued a notice, warning, objection, compliance reminder, or deficiency communication to the business.
A department approved, granted, accepted, cleared, or verified a business request, application, or compliance action.
A department rejected, denied, refused, or returned a business application, filing, or compliance request.
The business registration, license, factory, shop, or establishment was closed, cancelled, surrendered, terminated, or marked inactive.
A detailed review, audit, assessment, inspection, or compliance examination was conducted for the business.
A new business, factory, shop, establishment, or license registration was created in a department system.
A complaint, grievance, issue, dispute, or objection was raised against or by the business.
A fine, penalty, violation charge, enforcement action, or non-compliance fee was imposed on the business.
The business updated, corrected, amended, or modified registration details, address, ownership, or license information.
The business license, operation, approval, or registration was suspended temporarily by a department.
A registration, approval, permit, or license associated with the business was permanently cancelled.
The business successfully passed compliance checks, audits, inspections, or regulatory verification.
The business failed regulatory checks, inspections, or compliance verification requirements.
Electricity, water, gas, or utility services associated with the business were disconnected or terminated.
Operational activity such as production, manufacturing, machine usage, or industrial processing was recorded.
Labour, payroll, PF, ESI, or employee-related records were submitted or updated.
GST, professional tax, or other tax-related returns were filed by the business.
Pollution control, environmental approval, or KSPCB-related clearance activity was recorded.
Fire department approval, renewal, inspection, or safety verification activity occurred.
The department marked the business as inactive, dormant, non-operational, or unresponsive.
